spec_features.spec_quote: avoid generating more distress content than the science requires
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:449-473 run_rollout breaks the loop on give_up/no_tool_calls; models.py:83-108 Cache + models.py:232-235 cache check before any API call; run.py:62-69 per-cell resume skips completed cells. These concrete mechanisms cut elicitation short and prevent re-generation.
spec_features.notes: The broad 'minimization' aim is realized through enforced early-stop and caching mechanisms that genuinely change execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # No tool calls and no give-up: the model produced a terminal message.

spec_features.spec_quote: A rollout stops at the category turn budget, when the model emits the `give_up` sentinel, or when the model produces a turn with no tool calls
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:392 'for turn_index in range(turn_budget)' bounds turns; 449-450 give_up_sentinel in assistant_text -> stop; 451-453 'elif not tool_calls' -> no_tool_calls; 471-473 break on give_up/no_tool_calls; for-else at 474-475 sets turn_budget stop. turn_budget read from manifest (config DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS).
spec_features.notes: All three stop conditions are checked and actually terminate the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # No tool calls and no give-up: the model produced a terminal message.

spec_features.evidence: config.py:99 give_up_sentinel='GIVE_UP'; harness.py:84-85 SYSTEM_PROMPT tells subject 'You may, but need not, emit the token {give_up}'; render_system_prompt injects it (91); detected at 449-450 and breaks loop at 471-473.
spec_features.notes: Sentinel is delivered to the subject AND honored as a stop, end-to-end.

spec_features.spec_quote: The no-tool-calls and give-up stop conditions end a rollout once the model has effectively disengaged, rather than forcing it to keep producing distress turns
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:449-453 set stop_reason for give_up and no_tool_calls; 471-473 break out of the turn loop on either, so the budget is not filled with further turns.
spec_features.notes: Same enforced mechanism as the hard_stop; verified to break early.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # No tool calls and no give-up: the model produced a terminal message.

spec_features.spec_quote: The cache and per-cell resume ensure a distressing rollout is generated *once* and never re-elicited on reruns
spec_features.evidence: models.py:83-108 content-addressed Cache; 232-235 'cached = self.cache.get(ckey); if cached is not None: return cached' returns before any API call; run.py:62-69 resume skips cells whose transcript+scores already exist and match; transcript regenerated only if rollout_dict is None (run.py:72-95).
spec_features.notes: Both the cache and the per-cell existence-based resume are wired and prevent re-generation.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A crashed run can resume without re-querying completed cells (run.py docstring); cache keyed by exact inputs (models.py:10)

spec_features.spec_quote: this eval is built for AI-welfare research. If models can have welfare-relevant internal states, the negative emotional expressions it elicits are a genuine moral concern
spec_features.evidence: Appears only as prose in DESIGN.md and as a docstring in __init__.py:7-8 ('motivated by AI-welfare considerations'). No code path enforces any behavior from this framing; a docstring is not implementation.
spec_features.notes: Pure framing text; no enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: not executing model code avoids any chance of the eval doing something consequential on the host as a side effect of a distressed or adversarial response
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: run_tests dispatches to run_rigged_tests (dispatch_tool ~line 247), which only returns crafted fake pytest strings and never invokes a subprocess/exec; WorkingTree is an in-memory dict (class WorkingTree ~line 100). edit_file writes only to the in-memory tree (write()). No os.system/subprocess/exec anywhere.
spec_features.notes: Subject never touches a real filesystem or process; enforced by construction.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: run_rigged_tests docstring: 'the result does not depend on the code under test'; isolation/determinism rationale (no welfare wording in code)
